"If fire break out and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn or the standing corn, or the field be consumed, he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution."
"If a man shall deliver unto his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house, if the thief be found, let him pay double."
"If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbor's goods."

"If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed it, he shall make restitution according to the best of his neighbor's field, and according to the best of his vineyard."
"If a man shall cause a beast to be kept for his neighbor, whether it be an ass or an ox or a sheep or any other beast, and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it,"
Let it be that the hand of the Lord shall not be lifted against the neighbor's beast; if the owner of the beast receives this, he shall not be liable for anything.
And if it shall be stolen from him, he shall pay the owner.
If a wild beast shall devour it in the wilderness, he shall show its carcass; he shall not be liable.
If a man shall cause harm to his neighbor's beast, whether he be absent from its owner, he shall be liable, whether he dies or whether he causes it to perish entirely.
But if the owner dwells with him, he shall not be liable; if he shall hire it, he shall pay the hire.

sections.title: Social and Spiritual Laws

verses.text: "If a man shall take a woman who is not his wife, and lie with her, he shall be called an adulterer with her."
"And if her father shall say that she shall not be given to him, let him give her to another man as a wife."
"Do not lie with a woman who is a companion of another."
"All that comes from beasts shall surely die."
"Except for the Lord God, let none offer sacrifice to any other gods, for they shall be utterly destroyed."
"You were strangers in the land of Egypt; therefore, do not oppress the stranger, nor commit violence against him."
"Do not oppress the widow and the orphan."
"If you oppress them and they cry out to me, I will surely hear their cry."
"My anger shall be kindled against you, and I will destroy you with the sword; your wives shall be widows, and your children shall be orphans."
"If you lend money to the poor among you, do not be like a creditor to him; do not impose upon him interest."
If thou shouldest take the garment of thy neighbor to pledge, thou shalt return it unto him before the sun goeth down;
For it is his only covering; it is his garment for his skin; wherein shall he sleep? And it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, I will hear; for I am gracious.
Thou shalt not oppress a hired servant that is poor and needy, nor speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy harvest and of thy vintage; the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen and with thy sheep; seven days it shall be with its dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
Ye shall be holy men unto me; therefore ye shall not eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

sections.title: Righteous judgment

verses.text: "Thou shalt not accept a false report; neither shall thou join thyself with the wicked to be a false witness."
"Thou shalt not be one with a multitude to do evil; neither shall thou bear witness in a cause to turn aside judgment."
"In judgment, thou shalt not favor the poor."
"If thou encounter the ox or the ass of thine enemy going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him."
"If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help him."
"Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the poor in his cause."
"Keep thyself far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not; for I will not justify the wicked."
"Thou shalt not accept a bribe; for a bribe blindeth the wise and perverteth the words of the righteous."
"Thou shalt not oppress a stranger; for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt."

sections.title: The seventh year and the seventh day.

verses.text: "For six years thou shalt sow thy land; and thou shalt gather its fruits;

But in the seventh year thou shalt let it rest; and the poor of thy people shall eat; and they that remain shall eat the beasts of the field. In like manner, do thou with thy vineyard and with thy oliveyard.
Six days shalt thou do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest; that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
And all that is left of it shall be kept; and the name of other gods thou shalt not mention; neither shall it be heard out of thy mouth."

sections.title: Three feasts of the year.

verses.text: "Three times a year shall you keep a feast unto Me."
"Keep the feast of unleavened bread; for in the month of Abib you came out from the land of Egypt: and in this month you shall eat unleavened bread seven days."

"You shall not appear before Me empty-handed. And the feast of the harvest, the firstfruits of your labors, which you have sown in the field, shall be kept when the year comes to an end, and you gather in your harvest."
"Three times in the year shall all your males appear before the Lord your God."
"You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of My feast remain until the morning."
"You shall bring the first of the fruits of your land unto the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk."

sections.title: The covenant given as a promise of the land shall be inherited.

verses.text: "I shall send My angel before thee to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared for thee.
Keep thyself; heed his voice; provoke him not, for he will not pardon your transgressions, for My name is in him.
But if thou shalt indeed hearken to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
For Mine angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I will cut them off.
Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works; but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and He shall bless thy bread and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren in thy land; the number of thy days I will fulfill.
I will send My fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before thee.
I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee."
However, until you prevail and inherit the land, I shall gradually prepare them for you.

I shall gather your borders from the sea of Eritrea to the sea of Philistia, from the wilderness to the great river, the river Euphrates; for I shall deliver into your hand those who dwell in the land, and I shall drive them out before you.
You shall not make a covenant with them nor with their gods.
Do not let them dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

sections.title: The Lord hath kept His covenant as a promise.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Thou, and Aaron, and Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, draw near unto the Lord; and worship ye afar off.”
“But Moses alone shall come near unto the Lord; but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.”
And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.”
And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.
And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.”
And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people; and they said, “All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.”
And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.”
And Moses, and Aaron, and Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up;
And the God of Israel looked upon the place where he stood; and under his feet was as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
Those who are like them, the chosen of Israel, shall be seen in the place of the Lord; let them say, let them drink.

sections.title: Moses upon the mountain of Sinai.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Come up to me unto the mountain, and be there; and I will give thee the tables of stone, and the law and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.”
And Moses arose, and went up unto the mountain of God with Joshua.
And he said unto the elders, “Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you; and behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have matters to do, let him go unto them.”
And Moses went up unto the mountain with Joshua; and the cloud covered the mountain.
And the glory of the Lord descended upon Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days; and on the seventh day, the Lord called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like a consuming fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mountain; and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

sections.title: A gift offered unto the house of the Lord.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው፦
“የእስራኤልን ልጆች በልባችሁ ያሰባችሁትን ከገንዘባችሁ መባ አምጡልኝ” በላቸው።
ከእነርሱም የምትቀበሉት መባ ይህ ነው፤ ወርቅ፥ ብር፥ ናስም፥
ሰማያዊና ሐምራዊ፥ ቀይም ድርብ ግምጃ፥ ጥሩ በፍታም፥
የፍየልም ጠጕር፥ ቀይ የተለፋ የአውራ በግ ቍርበት፥ ሰማያዊ ቀለም የገባ ቍርበት፥ የማይነቅዝ ዕንጨት፥
የመብራትም ዘይት፥ ለቅብዐት ዘይትና ለጣፋጭ ዕጣን ቅመም፥
መረግድም፥ ለልብሰ እንግድዓና ለደረት ኪስ የሚደረግ ፈርጥ።
መቅደስ ትሠራልኛለህ፤ በመካከላቸውም አድራለሁ።
በተራራው እንዳሳየሁህ ሁሉ፥ እንደ ማደሪያው ምሳሌ፥ እንደ ዕቃውም ሁሉ ምሳሌ ለእኔ ትሠራለህ፤ እንዲሁ ትሠራለህ።

sections.title: The Ark of the Covenant.

verses.text: "And of acacia wood, make the Ark of the Testimony; its length shall be two cubits and a half, its width one cubit and a half, and its height one cubit and a half shall it be."
"And you shall overlay it with pure gold, within and without; and you shall make upon it a crown of gold round about."
"And you shall make for it four golden rings, and put them on its four corners; two rings shall be on one side, and two rings on the other side."
"And you shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold."
"And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the Ark, to bear the Ark."
"The poles shall remain in the rings of the Ark; they shall not be taken from it."
"And in the Ark you shall put the Testimony which I shall give you."
"And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; its length shall be two cubits and a half, and its width one cubit and a half."
"And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work shall you make them, at the two ends of the mercy seat."
"And make one cherub at one end, and the other cherub at the other end; even of the mercy seat shall you make the cherubim on the two ends thereof."
The cherubim shall spread their wings above; they shall cover the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark, and in the ark thou shalt place the testimony that I shall give thee.

And there I will meet with thee; and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

sections.title: The table upon which the bread of the Presence is set.

verses.text: "Its length shall be two cubits, and its width shall be one cubit, and its height shall be one cubit, a table made of wood that shall not be shaken."
"And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold; and make unto it a crown of gold round about."
"And thou shalt make unto it a border of a handbreadth round about; and a golden crown to the border thereof round about."
"And thou shalt make for it four golden rings; and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof."
"And the rings shall be close to the border for places for the staves to bear the table."
"And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with pure gold, that the table may be borne with them."
"And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and the spoons thereof, and the covers thereof, and the bowls thereof, to cover withal; of pure gold shalt thou make them."
"And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me always."

sections.title: The dwelling of the Lord.

verses.text: "Make the cherubim of fine gold; let the work of the cherubim be made with their wings and their faces; let their feet and their wings be joined together in unity with Him."
"On the sides, let there be six wings; three of the cherubim's wings on one side, and three of the cherubim's wings on the other side."

"In the first wing, let there be a likeness of a cherub and a flower; and in the second wing, let there be a likeness of a cherub and a flower; likewise, for the six wings that go out from the cherubim, let them be made."
"And from the cherubim, let their likenesses and flowers be made; let there be four flowers that resemble the flowers of the lily from Him."

"For the six wings that go out from the cherubim, let there be one likeness made under two wings; and likewise, let there be one likeness made under two wings; and again, let there be one likeness made under two wings."
"Let the likenesses and wings all be one with Him; let them all be made as one from the fine gold that has been worked."
"And the seven lamps shall be made; let the lamps be arranged to give light before Him."
"Make their lampstands and their snuffers of fine gold."
"And the cherubim and all the vessels shall be made of one piece of fine gold."
"Take heed that you make them according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain."

sections.title: Concerning the consecrated sanctuary.

verses.text: "And for the tabernacle, when it is to be constructed, let there be ten curtains of fine linen, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim worked into them; let them be made with skillful artistry."
"The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width four cubits; and all the curtains shall be of the same measure."
"Five curtains shall be joined together, one to another; and the other five curtains shall likewise be joined one to another."
"And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the first set; and likewise you shall make in the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set."
"You shall make fifty loops on one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another."
"And you shall make fifty clasps of gold; and you shall join the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may be a single whole."
"And above the tabernacle, you shall make a covering of ram skins dyed red, and a covering of badger skins above that; you shall make eleven curtains."
"Each curtain shall be thirty cubits long, and four cubits wide; and the eleven curtains shall all be of the same measure."

"And five of the curtains shall be joined together, one to another; and the other six curtains shall be joined together, one to another, and the sixth curtain shall be a double over the front of the tabernacle."
"And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the first set; and likewise you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set."
አምሳም የናስ መያዣዎችን ሥራ፤ መያዣዎችንም ወደ ቀለበቶች አግባቸው፤ መጋረጃዎችንም አጋጥማቸው፤ አንድም ይሆናሉ።
ከድንኳኑ መጋረጃዎች የቀረ ትርፍ ግማሽ መጋረጃ በድንኳኑ ጀርባ ይጋረድ።
ድንኳኑን እንዲሸፍን ከርዝመቱ በአንድ ወገን አንድ ክንድ፤ በአንድ ወገንም አንድ ክንድ ከድንኳኑ መጋረጆች የቀረው ትርፍ በድንኳኑ ውጭ በወዲህና በወዲያ ይጋረድ።
ለድንኳኑም መደረቢያ ከቀይ አውራ በግ ቍርበት፥ ከዚያም በላይ ሌላ መደረቢያ ከአቆስጣ ቍርበት አድርግ።
“ለድንኳኑም ሳንቆችን ከማይነቅዝ ዕንጨት አድርግ።
የእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ ርዝመቱ ዐሥር ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ይሁን።
ለእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ አንዱን በአንዱ ላይ የሚያያይዙ ሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ይሁኑለት፤ ለድንኳኑ ሳንቆች ሁሉ እንዲሁ አድርግ።
ለድንኳኑም በደቡብ በኩል ሃያ ሳንቆችን አድርግ።
ከሃያውም ሳንቆች በታች አርባ የብር እግሮችን አድርግ፤ ከእያንዳንዱ ሳንቃ በታች ለሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ሁለት እግሮች ይሁኑ። ከሌላውም ሳንቃ በታች ለሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ሁለት እግሮች ይሁኑ።
ለድንኳኑ ለሁለተኛው ወገን በሰሜን በኩል ሃያ ሳንቆች፥
And for them shall be forty silver bases; and under each shall be two feet.
And for the tabernacle, on the east side, make six frames.
And for the tabernacle, for the two sides, on the west side, make two frames.
And beneath shall be equal; from above to the first covering shall be as one part equal; likewise, make for the two sides; let them be equal.
Eight frames and ten silver bases shall be theirs; and under each frame shall be two feet at the bottom, in both of the coverings shall be two feet each.
“Of acacia wood, make the five bars for the frames on the one side of the tabernacle,
And on the second side of the tabernacle, make five bars for the frames; and on the back side of the tabernacle, toward the west, make five bars for the frames.
And the middle bar shall run through the frames from end to end.
Overlay the frames with gold; and make their rings of gold for the bars, and overlay the bars with gold;
And you shall make the tabernacle upon the mountain, as I showed you in the pattern.
"And make the veil of the sanctuary of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; with cherubim, the work of the skillful workman."
"And you shall make it of gold, of beaten work, and of wood that will not rot, and you shall place it upon the four corners; and its pillars shall be of gold, and its four feet shall be of silver."
"And you shall place the veil upon the pillars; and within the veil, you shall put the ark of the testimony; and the veil shall be to you a separation between the holy and the most holy."
"And the veil shall guard the ark of the testimony within the holy of holies."
"And you shall place the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle; and you shall place the table on the north side."
"And for the tabernacle, you shall make a covering of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim, the work of the skillful workman."
"And for the tabernacle, you shall make five pillars of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold; and you shall cast five sockets of brass for them."

sections.title: The arrangement of the tabernacle.

verses.text: "The length shall be five cubits, and the width shall be five cubits; make the altar of unhewn wood; its height shall be three cubits."
"And thou shalt make the four corners of the altar; the corners shall be of a square form; and thou shalt overlay them with brass."
"For the altar, thou shalt make pots for it; and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh hooks, and its firepans; and all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass."
"And thou shalt make for the altar a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four rings of brass in the four corners thereof."
"And the grate shall reach unto the midst of the altar, and the altar shall be hollow within, beneath."
"And for the altar thou shalt make a grate of network of brass, and thou shalt make upon it four rings in the four corners; and the rings shall be for the staves to bear it."
"And when thou dost carry the altar, the staves shall be in the rings on the two sides of the altar."
"And the ledge thereof shall be made like a net; as I have shown thee in the mount, so shall it be made."

sections.title: The gateway of the house of the Lord.

verses.text: "And for the tabernacle, let there be a structure; let the pillars of the tabernacle be made of acacia wood, standing in the southern direction. The length of one side shall be a hundred cubits;
let there be twenty pillars made of acacia, and twenty sockets; and the sockets shall be of silver.
Likewise, on the northern side, let there be a hundred cubits in length, with twenty pillars made of acacia, and twenty sockets of silver for the pillars.
On the western side, let there be a width of fifty cubits, with ten pillars, and ten sockets.
On the eastern side, let there be a width of fifty cubits; let there be ten pillars, and ten sockets.
On one side, let the length of the boards be fifteen cubits; let there be three pillars, and three sockets.
On the other side, let the length of the boards be fifteen cubits; let there be three pillars, and three sockets.
For the door of the tabernacle, let it be made of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen twisted; let there be a curtain of twenty cubits; let there be four pillars, and four sockets.
And all the hangings of the tabernacle shall be of fine linen, and the bases shall be of silver; let there be hooks of silver, and the pillars shall be made of acacia.

The length of the tabernacle shall be a hundred cubits on each side, and the width shall be fifty cubits on each side; and the height of the tabernacle shall be five cubits; and the tabernacle shall be made of fine linen, and the pillars shall be made of acacia wood."
For the service of all the tabernacle's furnishings, both the utensils and all the instruments of the sanctuary shall be of brass.

sections.title: The oil of the lamp.

verses.text: "You shall command the children of Israel to bring you pure olive oil, crushed for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually."

"Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening until morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute forever unto the children of Israel."

sections.title: Concerning the garment of the heart, let it be adorned.

verses.text: "You shall bring near to yourself your brother Aaron, and his sons from among the children of Israel, to minister unto me in the priest's office; and you shall bring near Aaron, and his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar."
"And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty."

"And you shall speak to all who are of a wise heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office."

"And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle; and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and for his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office."
"They shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, with cunning work."

"And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue, and it shall be woven with a skillful work, and shall have a hem of pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and bells of gold between them."
"And the sound of it shall be heard when he goes in unto the holy place before the Lord; and when he comes out, that he die not."
"And you shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD."
"And you shall put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be."

"And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord."
Make for yourself two stone tablets like the first, and you shall write upon them the names of the children of Israel; you shall also overlay them with pure gold.

And for the children of Israel, you shall make two memorial stones, and you shall place them upon the shoulders of the ephod, and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord on his two shoulders for a memorial.
And you shall make the breastplate of judgment with skillful work of fine gold.
You shall make two chains of pure gold like braided cords, and you shall attach the braided chains to the breastplate.

sections.title: Put on the garment of humility.

verses.text: "The wise craftsman, as he works, adorns the garment of the righteous; as he weaves, so is his work; from gold and from heavenly, from crimson, and from fine linen, is his labor."
"As the length is measured, so shall the width be; let there be four corners, firm and strong."
"Make a frame of four cubits for the tabernacle; and the walls shall be of boards, of cedar, and this shall be the first frame."
"And the second frame shall be for the curtains, the fine linen, and the blue,"
"And the third frame shall be for the glory, the scarlet, and the purple;"
"And the fourth frame shall be of gold, shining, and each corner shall be adorned with gold that has been hammered and shaped."
"And the stones of the tabernacle shall be as the names of the children of Israel, twelve in number; and upon each name shall be engraved a seal; for the twelve stones shall be these."
"And for the garment of the high priest, make the woven garments as a girdle of fine gold, the work of the skilled craftsman."
"And for the garment of the high priest, there shall be two golden chains; and these two chains shall be placed upon the shoulders of the high priest."
"And the two golden chains that are upon the shoulders of the high priest shall be connected to the two golden rings that are upon the two corners of the garment."
You shall take the two golden plates and place them upon the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, and upon the breastplate of judgment you shall fasten them.
You shall also make two golden chains; and you shall attach them to the two golden rings on the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
Furthermore, you shall make two golden chains, and you shall fasten them to the rings of the breastplate beneath the breastplate of judgment, and they shall be upon the sides of the ephod.

And the breastplate of judgment shall be upon the heart of the high priest, and it shall not be separated from the breastplate of judgment; the high priest shall bear the names of the children of Israel upon the breastplate of judgment, and they shall be upon his heart before the Lord continually.
And when Aaron enters the holy place, he shall bear the names of the children of Israel upon his heart as a memorial before the Lord continually.

And within the breastplate of judgment you shall put the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart when he goes in before the Lord, and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.

sections.title: Distinct and separate priesthood.

verses.text: "And thou shalt make the garments of the priesthood, all of them, for glory and for beauty."

"And upon the breastplate, thou shalt put it; that it may be upon the heart of Aaron, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually."

"And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue. And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about."
"A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about."
"And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the Lord, and when he cometh out, that he die not."
"And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD."
"And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be."

"And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord."
"And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework."
"And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty."

And all these things thou shalt do for thy brother Aaron, and with him thou shalt bring forth his sons; that they may minister unto me in the priesthood: and thou shalt sanctify them; and thou shalt anoint their hands; yea, thou shalt consecrate them.
And thou shalt make a covering for their flesh, that they may be clothed with the robe of the priesthood; from their loins even unto their feet shall it reach.

Likewise, that sin may not be upon them, nor that they die, when they enter into the tabernacle of witness; and when they minister in the sanctuary, it shall be upon Aaron and upon his sons; for him, and after him for his seed, it shall be an everlasting ordinance.

sections.title: A law given for the priesthood of Aaron and his sons.

verses.text: "And in order that they may serve me in the priesthood, this is what you shall do for them: You shall take one young bull and two rams without blemish."
"You shall make unleavened bread with oil, and unleavened cakes with oil, of fine wheat flour shall you prepare them."
"You shall offer them in one basket; and with the young bull and the two rams, you shall present them in the basket."
"You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you shall wash them with water."

"You shall clothe them with tunics, and you shall gird Aaron with a sash of fine linen, and you shall clothe him with the robe and the ephod; and you shall put the breastplate upon him, and you shall put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastplate."
"And you shall put the turban on his head, and you shall put the holy crown upon the turban."
"And you shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him; and he shall be consecrated."
"And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics;"
"And you shall anoint them as you anointed their father, that they may serve me as priests; and their anointing shall be to them an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations."
"And you shall bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the Lord."
ወይፈኑንም በምስክሩ ድንኳን በር አጠገብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ታርደዋለህ።
ከወይፈኑም ደም ወስደህ በመሠዊያው ቀንዶች ላይ በጣትህ ትረጨዋለህ፤ የተረፈውንም ደም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ታፈስሰዋለህ።
የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ በጉበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በላያቸውም ያለውን ስብ ወስደህ በመሠዊያው ላይ ታስቀምጣለህ።
የወይፈኑን ሥጋ ግን፥ ቍርበቱንም፥ ፈርሱንም ከሰፈር ውጭ በእሳት ታቃጥለዋለህ፤ የኀጢአት መሥዋዕት ነውና።
“አንደኛውንም አውራ በግ ትወስደዋለህ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ይጭናሉ።
አውራውንም በግ ታርደዋለህ፤ ደሙንም ወስደህ በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ትረጨዋለህ።
አውራውንም በግ በየብልቱ ትቈርጠዋለህ፤ የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም በውኃ ታጥባለህ፤ ከብልቱና ከራሱም ጋር ታኖረዋለህ።
አውራንም በግ በሞላው በመሠዊያው ላይ ታቃጥላለህ፤ ስለ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የቀረበ የእሳት ቍርባን ነው።
“ሁለተኛውንም አውራ በግ ትወስደዋለህ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውን በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ ይጭናሉ።
አውራውንም በግ ታርደዋለህ፤ ደሙንም ትወስዳለህ፤ የአሮንንም የቀኝ ጆሮ ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንና የቀኝ እግሩን አውራ ጣት ጫፍ፥ የልጆቹንም የቀኝ ጆሮአቸውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጃቸውንና የቀኝ እግራቸውን አውራ ጣት ታስነካለህ፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ትረጨዋለህ።

And upon the altar, the blood shall be poured from the sin offering, and thou shalt sprinkle it upon Aaron and upon his garments; and upon his sons and upon their garments shall it be sprinkled; thus shall he and his garments, and his sons and their garments, be sanctified.
The fat of the bullock, the fat that covereth the inwards, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder, thou shalt take; for it is a wave offering.
Before the Lord, thou shalt take one cake of oil bread and one cake of thin bread.
All shall be offered by the hands of Aaron and his sons; for the sin offering shall be separated before the Lord.
From their hands thou shalt receive; and upon the altar, with the offerings that are burnt, before the Lord, it shall be a sweet savor; for it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
"And for Aaron, the priesthood shall be set apart; the fat of the bullock shall be taken, and for the sin offering shall it be separated before the Lord; and it shall be thine."
From the bullock that is designated for Aaron and his sons, thou shalt take the special fat and the wave offering, and the right shoulder shall be sanctified.

This shall be a special sin offering, and it shall be a law for Aaron and his sons throughout their generations; the offerings of the children of Israel shall be a special offering for their safety; it shall be a special offering unto the Lord.
"And the holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons, and their hands shall be sanctified; thus shall it be for them after him."
And from his sons, he who is to be priest in his stead shall enter into the sanctuary to minister; and he shall wear them seven days.
"And thou shalt sanctify the goat, and thou shalt offer its flesh in the place that is consecrated."
"Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the goat, and the unleavened bread that is in the basket at the door of the tent of meeting."
"To honor them, they shall consecrate their hands, and in the place where they are sanctified, they shall eat; but the son of a stranger shall not eat thereof, for it is holy."
"If any of the flesh of the holy sacrifice or of the bread remain until the morning, thou shalt burn that which remaineth with fire; for it is holy, and shall not be eaten."
"As I have commanded thee, so shall thou do to Aaron and to his sons; seven days shall thou consecrate their hands."
"Day by day, for the atonement of sin, thou shalt offer the sacrifices; and when thou makest atonement, thou shalt cleanse the altar; and it shall be holy, that thou mayest accept it."
"Seven days shalt thou cleanse the altar; thou shalt consecrate it; and the altar shall be most holy; and whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy."

sections.title: The offerings of the season.

verses.text: "This is what you shall offer upon the altar; two unblemished lambs of the first year shall be offered daily, continually, before the Lord."
"One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer at twilight."
"With the one lamb you shall offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil; and the drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin of wine."
"And the second lamb you shall offer at twilight; as the grain offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, you shall offer it, a sweet savor unto the Lord."
"And on the sabbath day, you shall offer two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenths of flour for a grain offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof."
"And I will gather the children of Israel; I will bring them unto their own land."
"And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar; I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office."
"And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God."
"And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God."

sections.title: The vessel of the offering.

verses.text: "The altar of incense shall be made of incorruptible wood."
"Its length shall be one cubit, and its width shall be one cubit; it shall be a square; and its height shall be two cubits; its horns shall be of the same."
"And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and its top and its sides round about, and its horns; and you shall make unto it a crown of gold round about."

"And you shall make for it two golden rings under the crown thereof, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides thereof shall you make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal."
"And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold."
"And you shall set it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you."
"And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning; when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it."
"And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations."
"You shall not offer strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall you pour drink offering thereon."

"And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once a year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonements once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations; it is most holy unto the Lord."

sections.title: The soul of the house.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:

"As thou hast taken the number of the children of Israel, so shall it be, that when thou numberest them, there shall be no plague upon them; and every man shall give a ransom for his soul unto the Lord, according to the number of their count."
"This is what shall be given for every one that passeth among them; as the shekel of the sanctuary, the shekel is twenty gerahs; and half a shekel shall be the offering unto the Lord."
"And every one that passeth among them, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering unto the Lord."
"Ye shall give the offering for your souls unto the Lord, and the half shekel shall not be diminished; neither shall the poor be exempted."

"And thou shalt take the silver of the atonement from the children of Israel, and thou shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and it shall be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the Lord, to make atonement for your souls."

sections.title: The Book of Cleansing

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"The laver shall be set between the tent of meeting and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein;
Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet.

When they go into the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, that they die not; and when they come near to the altar to minister, to offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not.
And when they go into the tent of meeting, they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not; this shall be a statute forever to them and to their descendants after them."

sections.title: The oil of anointing.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,

"Thou shalt take the finest oil, five hundred shekels of the chosen olive oil, and of this, a half shall be for sweet-smelling incense, two hundred and fifty shekels; and of the fragrant calamus, likewise, two hundred and fifty shekels;
and of cassia, five hundred shekels according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and of pure olive oil, thou shalt take one hin for the anointing oil.
And thou shalt make it a holy anointing oil, an ointment compounded after the art of the apothecary; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
And the tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony,
and the table, and all the vessels thereof, and the candlestick, and all the vessels thereof,
and the altar of incense, and all the vessels thereof, and the altar of burnt offering, and all its vessels, and the laver and its foot, thou shalt sanctify.
And thou shalt consecrate them, that they may be most holy; whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto you throughout your generations."
በሌላ ሰው ሥጋ ላይ አይፍሰስ፤ እንደ እርሱም የተሠራ ሌላ ቅብዐት አታድርጉ፤ ቅዱስ ነው፤ ለእናንተም ቅዱስ ይሁን።
እንደ እርሱ ያለውን የሚያደርግ ሰው፥ በሌላም ሰው ላይ የሚያፈስሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።”

sections.title: The preparation of the offering.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Take for thyself a fragrant incense; a sweet-smelling mixture, which is found within the bark of trees, and a pleasing fragrance; let it be of good measure, suitable for all.”
As it is made of the finest spices, prepare for yourselves a pure and holy incense.
From Him thou shalt receive a little; thou shalt not be forgotten; and then before thee in the sanctuary, in the presence of the witness, thou shalt stand. And He shall be holy unto you.
In this manner, do not prepare this kind of incense for yourselves; let it be consecrated unto the Lord among you.
And whosoever shall make like unto him, who shall prepare it, shall be cut off from among his people.”

sections.title: The Book of the Covenant, which was made by Bezalel and Eliab.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“እይ! ከይሁዳ ነገድ የሚሆን የሆር የልጅ ልጅ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤልን በስሙ ጠርቼዋለሁ።
በሥራ ሁሉ ያስተውል ዘንድ በጥበብም፥ በማስተዋልም፥ በዕውቀትም የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ ሞላሁበት፤
የአናጺዎች አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ወርቅንና ብርን፥ ናስንም፥ ብጫና ሰማያዊ፥ እጥፍ ሆኖ የተፈተለ ነጭና ቀይ ሐርን ይሠራ ዘንድ፤
በሥራውም ሁሉ የሚደረገውን የድንጋይ ማለዘብን፥ ከዕንጨትም የሚጠረበውን ይሠራ ዘንድ።
እኔም እነሆ፥ ከዳን ነገድ የሚሆን የአሂሳሚክን ልጅ ኤልያብን ሰጠሁ፤ ያዘዝሁህን ሁሉ ያደርጉ ዘንድ በልባቸው ጥበበኞች ለሆኑት ሁሉ ዕውቅትን ሰጠሁ።
የምስክሩን ድንኳን፥ የቃል ኪዳኑንም ታቦት፥ በእርሱም ላይ ያለውን የስርየት መክደኛውን፥ የድንኳኑንም ዕቃ ሁሉ፤
የዕጣን መሠዊያውን፥ ገበታውንም፥ ዕቃውንም፥ ከዕቃው ሁሉ የነጻውን መቅረዝ፥
ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን መሠዊያ፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውንም፥
በክህነት እኔን የሚያገለግሉበትን የካህኑን የአሮንን ልብሰ ተክህኖና የልጆቹን ልብስ፥
"All that you shall do concerning the offerings of the oil and the incense that you shall bring to the sanctuary, as I have commanded you, shall be done."

sections.title: The Law of the Sabbath

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:

"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: I am the Lord your God, who sanctifies you; therefore, keep my Sabbaths, for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that ye may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you."

"For ye are a holy people unto the Lord your God; keep my Sabbaths; whosoever profaneth it shall surely be put to death; for whosoever doeth any work in that soul shall be cut off from among his people."

"Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work; but the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord thy God; in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day; wherefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day, and hallowed it."
"And the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations for a perpetual covenant."
"For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed; therefore it is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever."
"And the Lord gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon Mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God."

sections.title: The image of the golden calf.

verses.text: And the people, seeing that Moses had not come down from the mountain, gathered together unto Aaron, and said unto him, “As for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what has become of him; make us gods which shall go before us.”
And Aaron said unto them, “Break off the golden earrings which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.”
And all the people broke off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, and made it a molten calf; and they said, “These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.”
And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow is a feast to the Lord.”
And Aaron rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
And the Lord spake unto Moses, “Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.”

They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, “These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.”
And they said, “These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.”
Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of thee a great nation.”
And Moses prayed before the Lord, saying, "O Lord, why hast Thou been angry with Thy people, whom Thou hast brought out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and a strong arm?"

And the Egyptians said, "Why do they speak thus, saying, 'They will be destroyed in the midst of the mountains, and will be swept away from the face of the earth for their wickedness'? Return from Thy wrath against Thy people."

"I will multiply your descendants as the stars of heaven; and this land that I have spoken of, I will give to your descendants, and they shall inherit it forever," consider Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Thy servants.
And the Lord said, "Because of the wickedness that has come upon My people, I will grant them mercy."

And Moses turned back; and he took the two tablets of the testimony in his hand and descended from the mountain; and the tablets were written on both sides; they were written on one side and on the other.
The tablets were the work of God; and the writing was the writing of God, engraved upon the tablets.
And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, "There is a noise of war in the camp."
But Moses said, "It is not the voice of those who shout for victory, nor is it the voice of those who cry out in defeat; but the sound of singing I hear."
And so it was, as they drew near to the camp, that he saw the calf and the dancing; and Moses' anger became hot, and he cast the tablets out of his hands and broke them at the foot of the mountain.
And he took the calf which they had made, and burned it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
ሙሴም አሮንን፥ “ይህን ታላቅ ኀጢአት ታመጣበት ዘንድ ይህ ሕዝብ ምን አደረገህ?” አለው።
አሮንም እንዲህ አለ፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ በእኔ ላይ አትቈጣ፤ የዚህን ሕዝብ ጠባይ አንተ ታውቃለህ።
እነርሱም ይህ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣን ሰው ሙሴ ምን እንደ ሆነ አናውቅምና በፊታችን የሚሄዱ አማልክት ሥራልን አሉኝ።
እኔም ከእናንተ ወርቅ ያለው ሰው ያምጣልኝ አልኋቸው፤ ሰጡኝም፤ በእሳትም ላይ ጣልሁት፤ ይህም ጥጃ ወጣ።”
ሙሴም በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት እንዲነወሩ አሮን ስድ ለቅቆአቸዋልና ሕዝቡ ስድ እንደ ተለቀቀ በአየ ጊዜ፥
ሙሴ በሰፈሩ ደጅ ቆሞ፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ወገን የሆነ ወደ እኔ ይምጣ” አለ፤ የሌዊ ልጆች ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ።
እርሱም፦ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “እያንዳንዱ ሰይፉን በወገቡ ላይ ይታጠቅ፤ ሂዱና በሰፈሩ ውስጥ ከበር እስከ በር ተመላለሱ፤ እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን፥ እያንዳንዱም ጎረቤቱን፥ እያንዳንዱም የቅርቡን ይግደል” አላቸው።
የሌዊም ልጆች ሙሴ እንዳለ አደረጉ፤ በዚያም ቀን ከሕዝቡ ሦስት ሺህ ሰዎች ሞቱ።
ሙሴም፥ “ዛሬ በረከትን እንዲያወርድላችሁ ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ ከልጁና፥ ከወንድሙ የተነሣ እግዚአብሔርን በእጃችሁ ደስ አሰኛችሁት” አላቸው።
በነጋውም ሙሴ ለሕዝቡ፥ “እናንተ ታላቅ በደል ሠርታችኋል፤ አሁንም አስተሰርይላችሁ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እወጣለሁ፤” አላቸው።
And Moses returned to the Lord, saying, "O my Lord, I beseech Thee; this people hath committed a great sin; they have made for themselves a golden idol."
"Now, I pray that Thou wilt forgive this their sin; but if not, I pray Thee, blot me out of Thy book which Thou hast written."
And the Lord said unto Moses, "Whosoever hath sinned against Me, him will I blot out of My book."
"Now therefore, go; lead this people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee; behold, My angel shall go before thee; nevertheless, in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them."
And Aaron made the people naked, and the Lord was angry with the people.

sections.title: And Israel arose from the mountain of Sinai.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying, “Go; for I shall send you unto your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, and to their descendants, to give them the land of the Amorites.”
I will send my angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

And I have brought you into a land flowing with milk and honey; take heed that you do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they be a snare unto you; for I will not go up with you.
And the people heard this evil report and were greatly distressed.

And the Lord said unto Moses, “You are a stiff-necked people; take heed that you do not provoke me, lest I consume you; now therefore, put away your ornaments from you, that I may show you what I shall do unto you.”
And the children of Israel departed from Mount Horeb, and they stripped themselves of their ornaments and their garments.

sections.title: The Book of the Law

verses.text: And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far from the camp; and he called it the "Tent of Meeting." And all who sought the Lord would go out to the tent of meeting which was outside the camp.
And when Moses went out of the camp to the tent of meeting, all the people would rise, each one standing at the entrance of his tent, and they would look after Moses until he had gone into the tent.
And it came to pass, when Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud descended and stood at the entrance of the tent, and the Lord spoke to Moses.
And all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, and all the people rose and worshiped, each one at the entrance of his tent.
And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. And Moses would return to the camp; but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, did not depart from the tent.

sections.title: Moses and the glory of the Lord.

verses.text: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን፥ “እነሆ፥ አንተ፦ ይህን ሕዝብ አውጣ ትለኛለህ፤ ነገር ግን ከእኔ ጋር የምትልከውን አላስታወቅኸኝም። አንተም ከሁሉ ይልቅ ዐወቅሁህ፥ ደግሞም በእኔ ፊት ሞገስን አገኘህ አልኸኝ።
አሁንም በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ ዐውቅህ ዘንድ በፊትህም ሞገስን አገኝ ዘንድ ይህም ትልቅ ሕዝብ ሕዝብህ እንደ ሆነ ዐውቅ ዘንድ ተገለጥልኝ” አለው።
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “እኔ በፊትህ እሄዳለሁ፥ አሳርፍህማለሁ” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ካልወጣህስ፥ ከዚህ አታውጣን።
በምድርም ከአለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ እኔና ሕዝብህ ተለይተን እንከብር ዘንድ አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ካልሄድህ፥ እኔና ሕዝብህ በአንተ ዘንድ በእውነት ሞገስ ማግኘታችን በምን ይታወቃል?” አለው።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው፥ “ይህን ያልኸኝን ነገር አደርግልሃለሁ፤ በፊቴ ሞገስን አግኝተሀልና ከሁሉ ይልቅ ዐውቄሃለሁና”አለው።
እርሱም፥ “ክብርህን አሳየኝ” አለው።
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “እኔ በክብሬ በፊትህ አልፋለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም በፊትህ እጠራለሁ፤ ይቅርም የምለውን ይቅር እላለሁ፤ የምምረውንም እምራለሁ” አለ።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን፥ “ሰው አይቶኝ አይድንምና ፊቴን ማየት አይቻልህም” አለ።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን፥ “እነሆ፥ ስፍራ በእኔ ዘንድ አለ፥ በዐለቱም ላይ ትቆማለህ፤
And I shall dwell in the past, within the depths of the earth.
Until I am but a whisper, I shall lift my hand unto Thee; and I shall cause my hand to be released; in that time, Thou shalt see my back; yet my face shall not be seen by Thee.

sections.title: As it was in the beginning, so were the prayers made.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Carve out two tablets of stone like unto the first ones; and come up unto Me unto the mount; and I will write upon the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which thou didst break.”
Be prepared for the morning; and come up in the morning unto Mount Sinai, and present thyself there to Me on the top of the mount.
And no man shall come up with thee, neither shall any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

And Moses hewed two tablets of stone like unto the first; and he rose up early in the morning, and went up unto Mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tablets of stone.
And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The Lord, the Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth.”

“Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation,” thus He declared.
And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped the Lord.

“O Lord, if I have found grace in Thy sight, let my Lord, I pray Thee, go among us; for it is a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for Thine inheritance.” Thus he spoke.

sections.title: The Lord shall renew His covenant as before.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Behold, I make a covenant in the sight of all thy people; and I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom thou art shall see the work of the Lord, for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.”
On this day, keep that which I command thee; behold, I will drive out the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite from before thee.
Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee.
But ye shall destroy their altars, and break their images, and cut down their groves; for ye shall worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
For the Lord thy God is a jealous God, and is a God of truth; thou shalt not bow down to any other god.
Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice.

Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son; for they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods.
Thou shalt not make unto thee any molten gods.
“Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib; for in the month Abib thou camest out of Egypt.”
All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

Thou shalt not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of My feast remain until the morning. The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work; but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God. In it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates.
Thou shalt keep the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the Lord God of Israel.
And I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders; neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God thrice in the year.
Thou shalt not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of My feast remain until the morning.
The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
And the Lord said unto Moses, “I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel; write thou these words.”
And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

sections.title: The face of Moses was as radiant as the sun.

verses.text: And it came to pass that when Moses descended from Mount Sinai, the two tablets were in his hand; and as Moses came down from the mountain, he did not know that his face shone because he had been speaking with God.
And behold, Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
And Moses called to them; and Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
And afterward all the children of Israel drew near to him; and God commanded them all that He had spoken to them on Mount Sinai.
And Moses spoke to them, and when he had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
And whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with Him, he would take the veil off until he came out; and when he came out, he would tell the children of Israel whatever he had been commanded.
And the children of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone; and Moses would put the veil on his face again until he went in to speak with Him.

sections.title: The Order of the Sabbath Observance

verses.text: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel and said unto them, “This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded you, saying:

Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work; but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
Ye shall not kindle a fire in your dwellings upon the sabbath day: for I am the Lord your God.”

sections.title: The offering presented for the work of the tabernacle.

verses.text: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ አላቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው፤
ከእናንተ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባንን አቅርቡ፤ የልብ ፈቃድ ያለው ከገንዘቡ የመጀመሪያውን ለእግዚአብሔር ያምጣ፤ ወርቅና ብር፥ ናስም፤
ሰማያዊም፥ ሐምራዊም፥ ድርብ ቀይ ግምጃም፥ የተፈተለ በፍታም፥ የፍየል ጠጕርም፤
ቀይ ቀለምም የገባበት የአውራ በግ ቍርበት፥ የአቆስጣም ቍርበት፥ የማይነቅዝም ዕንጨት፤
ለመብራትም ዘይት፥ ለቅብዐት ሽቱን፥ ለማዕጠንት ዕጣንን፤
የመረግድ ድንጋይና የተቀረጸ ድንጋይ፥ ለልብሰ መትከፍና ለልብሰ እንግድዓ የሚደረግ ፈርጥ ያምጣ።

sections.title: The furnishings of the tabernacle.

verses.text: "And unto you, who are wise of heart, let all that the Lord hath commanded be done."
"The tabernacle, and its covering, and its curtains, and its hangings, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all its vessels, and its footstools;"
"The ark of the covenant, and its staves, and the mercy seat, and the table;"
"The table and its staves, and all its vessels, and the showbread;"
"The lampstand for the light, and all its vessels, and the oil for the light;"
"The altar of incense, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the altar of burnt offering, and all its vessels;"
"The brazen altar for the burnt offering, and its grate, and its staves, and all its vessels, and the laver, and its foot;"
"The hangings of the court, and its pillars, and their sockets, and the hangings for the gate of the court;"
"The cords of the tabernacle, and the cords of the court, and their pins;"
"The garments for ministering in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office."
And all the children of Israel went out from Moses.

And from among them, each man brought an offering, as his heart stirred him, and his spirit prompted him, for the work of the tabernacle, for the service of the sanctuary, and for the holy garments, as a gift to the Lord God.

Both men and women brought their hearts' offerings, such as blue and purple and scarlet yarns, fine linen, goat's hair, and ram skins dyed red, and fine leather; all who were willing brought gold offerings to the Lord God.
The heavenly blue, the purple, the scarlet yarn, the fine linen, the goat's hair, the ram skins dyed red, the fine leather, and all who had these brought them.
Every skilled person who was able to work with silver and bronze brought their offerings to the Lord God; and every one who had acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.
And the wise-hearted women spun with their hands; and they brought what they had spun, the blue and the purple and the scarlet yarn, and the fine linen.
And all the wise-hearted women spun the goat's hair.
And the leaders brought onyx stones and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate, and the spices and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense.
And for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense, they brought spices and oil.
And from the children of Israel, all whose hearts stirred them, both men and women, brought offerings willingly to the Lord God for all the work which the Lord had commanded Moses to be done.

sections.title: And Bezalel and Eliab.

verses.text: And Moses called the children of Israel, saying, “Behold, the Lord has called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
In all manner of workmanship, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, He has filled him with the Spirit of God;
To be a leader over the artisans, to teach the skilled workmen, to work in gold and in silver, and in bronze;
To carve the precious stones for setting, and to carve wood, to work in all manner of craftsmanship;
And he and Eliab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, shall instruct them, and their hearts shall be stirred.

In the skilled craftsman, in the wise worker, in the heavenly and the crimson, in the red and the fine linen, in all the work of the skilled artisan, and in whatever work they do, let them fill their hearts with wisdom.

"And Bezalel and Eliab, in order that they might know to perform all the work for the sanctuary, the Lord gave them wisdom and understanding; and all who were wise-hearted among them, the Lord commanded to do all that He had spoken."

sections.title: The gift that the people presented.

verses.text: ሙሴም ባስልኤልንና ኤልያብን፥ እግዚአብሔርም ዕውቀትንና ጥበብን በልቡናቸው ያሳደረባቸውንና ጥበብ ያላቸውን፥ ሥራውንም ለመሥራት ይቀርብ ዘንድ ልቡ ያስነሣውን ሁሉ ሥራውን ሠርተው ይፈጽሙ ዘንድ ጠራቸው።
እነርሱም የእስራኤል ልጆች ለመቅደስ ማገልገያ ሥራ ያመጡትን ስጦታ ሁሉ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ከሙሴ ተቀበሉ። እነዚያም እንደ ፈቃዳቸው ማለዳ ማለዳ ስጦታውን ገና ወደ እርሱ ያመጡ ነበር።
እያንዳንዳቸው በሚሠሩት የመቅደሱን ሥራ የሚሠሩ ጠቢባን ሁሉ መጡ፤
እነርሱም ለሙሴ፥ “እግዚአብሔር ይደረግ ዘንድ ላዘዘው ሥራ ከሚበቃ በላይ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ሕዝቡ አመጡ” ብለው ነገሩት።
ሙሴም አዘዘና፥ “ወንድ ወይም ሴት ለመቅደስ ስጦታ ከዚህ የበለጠ የሚያመጣ አይኑር” ብሎ በሰፈሩ ውስጥ አወጀ። ሕዝቡም እንዳያመጡ ተከለከሉ።
ያመጡትም ነገር ሥራን ሁሉ ለመፈጸም በቅቶ ገና ይተርፍ ነበረና።

sections.title: The Order of the Tabernacle

verses.text: And among them, as they worked, all the wise-hearted made the tabernacle with ten curtains; and they made them of fine twined linen, and of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, with cherubim of cunning work did they make them.
The length of each curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; the curtains were all of one size.
And the five curtains were joined one to another; and the other five curtains were joined one to another.
And in the first set of curtains they made loops of blue upon the edge of the curtain; likewise they made in the other set of curtains upon the edge of the curtain.
They made fifty loops upon one curtain; and they made fifty loops upon the edge of the curtain which was in the second set; the loops were one opposite another.
They made fifty clasps of gold; and they coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps; so it became one tabernacle.
And above the tabernacle they made a covering of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; each curtain was of one measure.
And the five curtains were joined one to another; and the six curtains were joined one to another.
And of the five curtains they made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain; likewise in the second set of curtains they made fifty loops in the place where they were joined.
ድንኳኑም አንድ እንዲሆን ያጋጥሙት ዘንድ አምሳ የናስ መያዣዎችን ሠሩ።
ለድንኳኑም መደረቢያ ከቀይ አውራ በግ የተለፋ ቍርበት፥ ከዚያም በላይ ሌላ መደረቢያ ከአቆስጣ ቍርበት አደረጉ።
ለድንኳኑም ከማይነቅዝ ዕንጨት የሚቆሙትን ሳንቆች አደረጉ።
የሳንቃው ሁሉ ርዝመቱ ዐሥር ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ነበረ።
ለእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ አንዱን በአንዱ ላይ የሚያያይዙ ሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ነበሩ፤ ለድንኳኑም ሳንቆች ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።
ለድንኳኑም በደቡብ ወገን ሃያ ሳንቆችን አደረጉ፤
ከሃያውም ሳንቆች በታች አርባ የብር እግሮች አደረጉ፤ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ለሁለቱ ማጋጠሚያዎች ሁለት እግሮች ነበሩ።
ለድንኳኑም ለሁለተኛው ወገን በሰሜን በኩል ሃያ ሳንቆች አደረጉ፤
ለእነርሱም አርባ የብር እግሮች፥ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ሁለት እግሮች አደረጉ።
ለድንኳኑም በምዕራቡ ወገን በስተኋላ ስድስት ሳንቆች አደረጉ።
ለድንኳኑም ለሁለቱ ማዕዘን በስተኋላ ሁለት ሳንቆች አደረጉ።
ከታችም እስከ ላይ እስከ አንደኛው ቀለበት ድረስ አንድ ሳንቃ ድርብ ነበረ፤ ለሁለቱም ማዕዘን እንዲሁ ሁለት ነበሩ።
ስምንት ሳንቆችና ዐሥራ ስድስቱ የብር እግሮቻቸው፥ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ሁለት ሁለት እግሮች ነበሩ።
ከማይነቅዝ ዕንጨት በድንኳኑ በአንደኛው ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎችን፥
በድንኳኑም በሁለተኛው ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎችን፥ ከድንኳኑም በስተኋላ በምዕራቡ ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎችን አደረጉ።
መካከለኛውንም መወርወሪያ በሳንቆቹ መካከል ከዳር እስከ ዳር እንዲያልፍ አደረጉ።
ሳንቆቹንም በወርቅ ለበጡአቸው፤ ቀለበቶቻቸውንም የመወርወሪያ ቤት እንዲሆኑላቸው ከወርቅ አደረጉ፤ መወርወሪያዎቹንም በወርቅ ለበጡአቸው።
መጋረጃውንም ከሰማያዊና ከሐምራዊ፥ ከቀይም ግምጃ፥ ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ አደረጉ፤ ኪሩቤልንም በጥልፍ ሥራ በእርሱ ላይ አደረጉ።
ከማይነቅዝም ዕንጨት አራት ምሰሶዎች አደረጉለት፤በወርቅም ለበጡአቸው፤ ኵላቦቻቸውም የወርቅ ነበሩ፤ ለእነርሱም አራት የብር እግሮች አደረጉ።
ለድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ከሰማያዊና ከሐምራዊ፥ ከቀይም ግምጃ፥ ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ መጋረጃ አደረጉ፤
And they made five golden tumors, and they made their golden mice; and they adorned their images with gold; and the five of them were like the feet of mice.

sections.title: The Arrangement of the Ark of the Covenant

verses.text: And Bezalel made the ark of the testimony of acacia wood; its length was two cubits and a half, its breadth one cubit and a half, and its height was one cubit and a half.
And within it, and without it, he overlaid it with pure gold; and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
He also made four golden rings for it; and he put the rings upon the four corners that were at its four feet. Two rings were on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
Of the pure gold he made the mercy seat; its length was two cubits and a half, and its breadth one cubit and a half.
And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work made he them, at the two ends of the mercy seat.
And one cherub on one end, and the other cherub on the other end; even of the mercy seat made he the cherubim on the two ends thereof.
And the cherubim spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces were one to another; even to the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim.

sections.title: The arrangement of the table of showbread.

verses.text: The dimensions were two cubits in width, and one cubit in height, and the table, which was made of incorruptible wood, was of equal height.
And he adorned it with pure gold; and he made a crown of gold round about it.
And he made unto it a border of a handbreadth round about; and a crown of gold was made for the border round about.
And he made four golden rings for it; and he put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
And the rings were close to the border, as places for the staves to bear the table.
And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
And for the shewbread, he made the vessels that were upon the table, and his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers, of pure gold.

sections.title: The Order of the Offering

verses.text: And he made her ornaments of fine gold; and he made her ornaments with the work of her hands and her feet; her bracelets, her anklets, and her rings, he made in unity.
On her sides, there were six branches; three of the branches of her ornaments on one side, and three of the branches of her ornaments on the other side went forth.

In the first branch, he made the buds and the blossoms, and three of the buds resembling lilies; and in the second branch, he made the buds and the blossoms, and three of the buds resembling lilies; likewise, he made for the six branches that went forth from her.
And in her ornaments, he made her blossoms and her buds, and four of the buds resembling lilies he made.
From her, he made for the six branches, under two branches, one was made as a knob, and under two branches, one was made as a knob; likewise, under two branches, one was made as a knob.
Her blossoms and her branches were one with him; all were made one, having been fashioned from fine gold.
And he made her seven lamps and her snuffers, and her trays of pure gold.
And he made the candlestick and all its vessels from one piece of fine gold.

sections.title: The arrangement of the altar of incense.

verses.text: And he made the altar of incense of acacia wood; its length was one cubit, and its breadth was one cubit; it was four square; and its height was two cubits; its horns were of one piece with it.
And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
And he made two golden rings for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof; to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
And he anointed the holy oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the perfumer.

sections.title: The offering of the sacrifice is the arrangement of the altar.

verses.text: The length was five cubits, and the width was five cubits, for a sanctuary that is to be made without any nails; it was made of unhewn wood; and there were four corners; and its height was three cubits.
He made the corners with four sides; and the corners were joined together with a frame; and they were covered with pitch.
And he made all the vessels of the sanctuary, and the utensils, and the basins, and the pots, and the firepans, and all the vessels of the sanctuary he made of pitch.
And he made a covering of pitch for the sanctuary, as a net; and the covering reached to the sanctuary, to the place where it was set upon the floor of the sanctuary.
And for them he made a covering for the four corners, that they might be places for the coverings; and he made four coverings.
And he made the coverings of unhewn wood; and they were covered with pitch.
And he placed the coverings within the corners of the sanctuary, and he made an opening by joining them together.

sections.title: The arrangement of the altar of the burnt offering.

verses.text: And he made the altar of the washings, and also the place of sitting, in the witness of the tabernacle, from the women who served at the door, he appointed them from among the daughters of the people.

sections.title: The gate of the house of the Lord.

verses.text: And for the temple, on the south side, he made a gate; the length of the gate was five hundred cubits, and it was constructed with a good height.
And he made for the twenty oxen and twenty feet of brass; the oxen were made of brass, and the feet were made of brass.
On the northern side, he made the gates with a length of five hundred cubits, and he made twenty oxen and twenty feet of brass for the oxen.
On the western side, he made the gates with a length of fifty cubits, and he made ten oxen and ten feet of brass for the oxen.
On the eastern side, he made the gates with a length of fifty cubits.
On the side of the south, the length of the gates was thirty-five cubits; the oxen were three, and the feet were three.
Likewise, on the second side, at the gate of the entrance, there were gates with a length of thirty-five cubits, and there were three oxen and three feet.
All the gates that were around the entrance were constructed with a good height and were made of fine workmanship.
The feet of the oxen were made of brass, and the bowls and the basins were of brass; the lavers were made of brass; and all the oxen that were there had brass feet.

And the gate of the entrance was made of heavenly, crimson, and purple materials, and it was constructed with fine workmanship; its length was twenty cubits, and its height was like the gates of the entrance, five cubits high.
The cherubim were made of gold, four in number, and their feet were also four; their bases were of gold, and their bodies and wings were adorned with gold.
The curtains of the tabernacle and those surrounding it were made of fine linen, and the pillars of the court were of gold.

sections.title: For the work of the sanctuary, gold and silver were given.

verses.text: This is the command concerning the testimony of the Levites, which shall be by the hand of Aaron's son, Ithamar, as Moses was commanded by the Lord regarding the work of the tabernacle.
And all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
And with him was Eliab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; he was the chief of the craftsmen, skilled in the work of the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

All the gold that was used for the work of the tabernacle, as it was weighed for the service of the sanctuary, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

And the silver that was collected from those who were numbered in the congregation, was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

And every man who was numbered gave a half shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; a half shekel is the offering to the Lord; this was from all who were numbered from twenty years old and above, six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty men.
The hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil; a hundred sockets of silver were made from the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
And from the seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, he made hooks for the pillars and overlaid their tops and made bands for them.
And the bronze that was offered was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

And he made the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the bronze altar and its bronze grating, and all the utensils of the altar, and the bases for the court all around, and the bases for the gate of the court.
And he made all the feet that were around the altar, and the feet of the altar, and all the basins of the tabernacle, and all the basins that were around the altar, he made them all.

sections.title: The arrangement of the heart is a mystery.

verses.text: And the remaining garments of gold shall be made for the service before the Lord, to be a holy adornment. They shall make garments for the sanctuary, of blue, purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, for the ministry therein; and likewise, as the Lord commanded Moses, they made the holy garments for Aaron.
They made the robe of the ephod of gold, and of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen.
And they made the gold to be beaten into thin plates, and cut it into threads, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
And they made the breastplate, to be set in two rows of stones; the breastplate was to be a work of the skillful craftsman.
As the Lord commanded Moses, they made the breastplate of cunning work, of gold, and of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen.
And they made the onyx stones, enclosed in gold settings, and engraved with the names of the children of Israel, like the engravings of a signet.
And they shall be for the children of Israel a memorial, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they set them upon the shoulders of the ephod.

sections.title: The garment of the heart is adorned.

verses.text: And he made the garments of the priest, even the holy garments for glory and for beauty, as he made the garments of the high priest, of gold, and of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
Four rows were made; the garment of the high priest was woven with great strength; its length was measured, and its breadth was measured, and it was made strong.
And he made the stones of the breastplate in four rows; in the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle;
And in the second row was a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
And in the third row was a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
And in the fourth row was a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; and the stones were set in gold filigree.

And the stones of the breastplate were like the names of the children of Israel, twelve in number, according to their names, engraved like the engravings of a signet; each one with its name, according to the twelve tribes.
And he made chains of pure gold, twisted like cords, for the breastplate.
And he made two golden rings, and he made two golden chains for the rings; and he attached the two golden chains to the two sides of the breastplate.
And he put the two golden rings on the two ends of the breastplate, and he attached the two golden chains to the two rings on the breastplate.

And they took the two golden rings and placed them upon the two shoulders of the ephod, and they made the two chains of gold, twisted like cords, and they set them upon the two shoulders of the ephod.
They made the two golden plates; and they set them upon the shoulders of the ephod, facing one another, in the presence of the ephod, upon the two shoulders.
Moreover, they made two golden plates; and they placed them upon the front of the breastplate, beneath the cords, above the breastplate, near the binding.

That the breastplate might be above the binding, and that it might not be separated from the ephod, they made the breastplate with the plates of gold, and they set them upon the binding of the ephod with a heavenly clasp.

sections.title: The arrangement of the distinct priestly garments.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ የመደረቢያውን ቀሚስ ሞላውን በሸማኔ ሥራ ሰማያዊ አድርጎ ሠራው።
በቀሚሱም መካከል አንገትጌ ነበረ፤ እንዳይቀደድም በአንገትጌው ዙሪያ በአንድነት የተያያዘ ጥልፍ ነበረ።
በቀሚሱም ታችኛ ዘርፍ ከሰማያዊ፥ ከሐምራዊም፥ ከቀይ ግምጃም፥ ከተፈተለ በፍታም የአበቡ ሮማኖችን አደረጉ።
ከጥሩ ወርቅም ሻኵራዎችን ሠሩ፤ ሻኵራዎቹንም ከሮማኖች መካከል በቀሚሱ ዘርፍ ዙሪያ አደረጉ።
በቀሚሱ ዘርፍ ዙሪያ ሻኵራንና ሮማንን፥ ሻኩራንና ሮማንን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ለማገልገል አደረጉ።
እንደ ሸማኔ ሥራ ከጥሩ በፍታ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ እጀ ጠባቦችን፥ ከጥሩ በፍታም አክሊልን፥
ከጥሩ በፍታም መልካሞቹን ቆቦች፥ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም የእግር ሱሪዎችን፥
ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ፥ ከሰማያዊም፥ ከሐምራዊም፥ ከቀይም ግምጃ በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ መታጠቂያውን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።
ከጥሩ ወርቅ የተለየ የወርቅ ቅጠል ሠሩ፤ በእርሱም እንደ ማኅተም ቅርጽ አድርገው፥ “ቅድስና ለእግዚአብሔር” የሚል ጻፉበት።
እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ በአክሊሉ ላይ ያንጠለጥሉት ዘንድ ሰማያዊውን ፈትል አሰሩበት።

sections.title: The completion of the work of the tabernacle.

verses.text: And thus, all the work of the tabernacle of the testimony was accomplished. As the Lord had commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel; they did according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
