And they brought unto Moses the tabernacle, and all its furniture, and its vessels, and the table, and its instruments, and the candlesticks, and all their vessels, and the altar of incense, and its vessels, and the altar of burnt offering, and all its vessels, and the laver and its base;

The entrance of the tabernacle was made of fine linen, embroidered with scarlet, and the door of the court was made of fine linen, embroidered with blue; and the screen for the entrance was made of fine linen, embroidered with scarlet;
The ark of the testimony, and its staves, and the mercy seat;
And the table, and all its vessels, and the showbread;
And the pure lampstand, and its lamps, and the oil for the light, and all the vessels thereof;
And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle;
And the bronze altar, and the bronze grate, and its staves, and all its vessels, and the laver, and its base;

And the hangings of the court, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and the hanging for the gate of the court, and all the cords, and all the instruments for the service of the tabernacle of the testimony;
And the garments for ministering in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office, they brought.
And the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
And Moses saw all the work; and behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded; thus they had done it. And Moses blessed them.

sections.title: The temple was established for the service of the Lord.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው፦
“በመጀመሪያው ወር በፊተኛው ቀን የምስክሩን ድንኳን ትተክላለህ።
በእርሱም ውስጥ የምስክሩን ታቦት ታኖራለህ፤ ታቦቱንም በመጋረጃ ትጋርዳለህ።
ገበታውንም ታገባለህ፤ በሥርዐቱም ታሰናዳዋለህ፤ መቅረዙንም አግብተህ ቀንዲሎቹን ትለኵሳለህ።
የወርቁንም ማዕጠንት በምስክሩ ታቦት ፊት ታኖራለህ፤ በድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ፊት መጋረጃውን ትጋርዳለህ።
ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውንም መሠዊያ በምስክሩ ድንኳን ደጅ ፊት ታኖረዋለህ።
የመታጠቢያውን ሰንም በምስክሩ ድንኳንና በመሠዊያው መካከል ታኖረዋለህ፤ በውስጡም ውኃ ትጨምርበታለህ።
በዙሪያውም አደባባዩን ትሠራለህ፤ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ ትዘረጋለህ።
የቅብዐቱንም ዘይት ወስደህ ድንኳኑን፥ በውስጥዋም ያለውን ሁሉ ትቀባለህ፤ እርስዋንም ዕቃዋንም ሁሉ ትቀድሳለህ፤ ቅድስትም ትሆናለች።
ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም የሚሆነውን መሠዊያ፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ትቀባዋለህ፤ መሠዊያውንም ትቀድሳለህ፤ መሠዊያውም ቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን ይሆናል።
የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውንም ቀብተህ ትቀድሳለህ።
አሮንንና ልጆቹንም ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን ደጃፍ አቅርበህ በውኃ ታጥባቸዋለህ።
ለአሮንም የተቀደሰውን ልብስ ታለብሰዋለህ፤ ትቀባዋለህ፤ ትቀድሰውማለህ፤ ካህንም ይሆነኛል።
ልጆቹንም ታቀርባቸዋለህ፤ ቀሚሳቸውንም ታለብሳቸዋለህ፤
አባታቸውን እንደ ቀባህ ትቀባቸዋለህ፤ ካህናትም ይሆኑኛል። ይህም ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘለዓለም የክህነት ቅብዐት ይሆንላቸዋል።”
ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረገ፤ እንዲሁም አደረገ።
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በፊተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ድንኳንዋ ተተከለች።
ሙሴም ድንኳንዋን ተከለ፤ እግሮችዋንም አኖረ፤ ሳንቆችዋንም አቆመ፤ መወርወሪያዎችዋንም አደረገባቸው፤ ምሰሶዎችዋንም አቆመ።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው መጋረጃውን በድንኳኑ ላይ ዘረጋው፤ የድንኳኑንም መደረቢያ በላዩ አደረገበት።
ሙሴም ጽላቱን ወስዶ በታቦቱ ውስጥ አኖረው፤ መሎጊያዎቹንም በታቦቱ ቀለበቶች ውስጥ አደረገ፤ የስርየት መክደኛውንም በታቦቱ ላይ አኖረው።
And he brought the tabernacle into the tent of the congregation, and he spread the covering over the tabernacle, as the witness commanded.
And the Lord commanded Moses, and he set the table in the tent of the congregation, outside the veil, and he placed it on the side of the tabernacle.
And he placed the bread of the Presence upon it before the Lord.
And the Lord commanded Moses, and he placed the lampstand in the tent of the congregation, before the table, on the side of the tabernacle.
And he lit the lamps before the Lord.
And the Lord commanded Moses, and he placed the golden altar in the tent of the congregation, before the veil.
And he prepared the incense for it.
And Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and he set the altar before the veil in the tabernacle.
And he placed the altar of incense in the tent of the congregation, as the witness commanded; and the Lord commanded Moses, and he offered upon it the incense and the offerings.
And he placed the basin between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and he put water therein for washing.
በእርሱም ሙሴና አሮን፥ ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውንና እግሮቻቸውን ታጠቡ፤
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን በገቡ ጊዜ፥ ወደ መሠዊያውም በቀረቡ ጊዜ ይታጠቡ ነበር።
በድንኳኑና በመሠዊያውም ዙሪያ አደባባዩን ሠራ፤ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ ዘረጋ። እንዲሁም ሙሴ ሥራውን ፈጸመ።

sections.title: The glory of the Lord hath filled His temple.

verses.text: And the cloud filled the tabernacle of the testimony; and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of the Lord.
And the cloud was upon the tabernacle by day, for the glory of the Lord had filled the tabernacle; therefore, Moses was not able to enter into the tabernacle of the testimony.
And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys.
But if the cloud was not taken up, then the cloud remained until the day that it was taken up.
For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
